title: Absorbable Sutures , Non Absorbable Sutures or Biologic Fibrin Glue for Protesic Mesh Fixing in Lichtenstein Technique for Primitive Groin Hernia Repair: a Randomized Prospective Multicentric Trial
brief_summary: this study has the aim to analize the correlation between three different methods of mesh fixation ( using absorbable or non absorbable sutures or fibrin biological glue) and recurrance and chronic pain ,in the Lichtenstein anterior inguinal erniorrhaphy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* primitive inguinal hernia
* age \> 18 years old
* compliancy to the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* reccurent inguinal hernia
* age \< 18 years old
* refusal of the study
